title: Force fields bending light seen in the Navy tic tac video

tellings.quote: >> The force fields interact with light when when when you see and you can see it on the tic tac video. the Navy pilots.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US Air Force site in Nevada, says the force fields around such craft bend light, and that you can see this in the Navy's 2004 Tic Tac video, footage taken by Navy pilots of a white oval object shaped like the mint. He offers it as his own reading of the footage, which if true would tie the Navy video to the craft he says he knew.
